node.statement: Nonvanishing and norm bounds: bijectivity of v:M_r->S_P makes S_P nonzero, so the compressed-corner definition's vanishing alternative makes P nonvanishing; dim S_Q=1 likewise makes Q nonvanishing. Hence the nonvanishing delta-projection alternative gives universal bounds ||P||,||Q||<=M_1 for all sufficiently small e.
